priority_classes.B: Preservation/visibility comparison with regional archaeological support

targets.name: Eastern Cholistan desert margins
targets.bbox_definition: Hand-drawn editorial planning rectangle,0.1-degree precision; overlapping, not measured site boundary
targets.missingness_mechanism: dunes and incomplete legacy location records
targets.target: Khundowala and Mulhiawala proposals plus comparison desert margins
targets.competing_explanation: Natural dune/soil anomalies or later mounds
targets.falsification_test: Ground-check proposed clusters; date intact occupation and compare matched noncandidate tiles
targets.comparison_stratum: Similar dunes and moisture settings without classifier peaks
targets.field_feasibility: not assessed; permits, local collaboration, access and recent land use require verification
targets.status: exploratory search hypothesis; no new discovery
